defmodule MyApp.Ticket do
  use Ash.Resource, domain: MyApp, data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "ticket"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :channels, {:array, MyApp.Enums.Channel},
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true

    attribute :priority, MyApp.Enums.Priority, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
    end
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]
  end
end
